description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for managing a tool stream interface, including handling agent events, formatting output, managing stream state, and handling lifecycle and fallback events within a UI context.

methods.name: toTrimmedString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string or null if not a string.

methods.name: resolveModelLabel
methods.description: Resolves provider and model info into a standardized label string.

methods.name: parseFallbackAttemptSummaries
methods.description: Parses an array of fallback attempt summaries into strings.

methods.name: parseFallbackAttempts
methods.description: Parses an array of fallback attempt objects into structured FallbackAttempt instances.

methods.name: extractToolOutputText
methods.description: Extracts text content from a tool output object.

methods.name: formatToolOutput
methods.description: Formats and truncates tool output for display.

methods.name: buildToolStreamMessage
methods.description: Builds a message object for a tool stream entry.

methods.name: trimToolStream
methods.description: Trims the tool stream to maintain a maximum number of entries.

methods.name: syncToolStreamMessages
methods.description: Synchronizes chat tool messages with current stream entries.

methods.name: flushToolStreamSync
methods.description: Immediately synchronizes the tool stream messages.

methods.name: scheduleToolStreamSync
methods.description: Schedules a throttled sync of the tool stream messages.

methods.name: resetToolStream
methods.description: Resets the tool stream state and timers.

methods.name: handleCompactionEvent
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events related to data compaction.

methods.name: handleLifecycleCompactionEvent
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events related to lifecycle cleanup.

methods.name: resolveAcceptedSession
methods.description: Determines if a session is accepted based on sessionKey and runId.

methods.name: handleLifecycleFallbackEvent
methods.description: Handles fallback events related to model switching and errors.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Main entry point for processing agent events and dispatching to specific handlers.
